$comment: How this game is shipped: its site (web: the Cloudflare Pages project the deploy and PR-preview workflows publish to), the files its packaged bundle must carry (bundledAssets, checked by scripts/check-offline-assets.mjs) and its desktop app (desktop, staged by scripts/stage-desktop.sh). The workflows list the games from these files (scripts/games.mjs). See docs/agents/new-game.md.
